pin_title: 4 Cosy Indoor Halloween Decorations UK Homes Love This Year
pin_title_alt: Easy Ways to Make Your Living Room Feel Halloween-Ready
pin_hook: Warm, spooky touches for the whole house
pin_description: Cosy indoor Halloween decorations UK shoppers rate highly: flameless pillar candles, pumpkin and bat fairy lights, a balloon garland arch and posable skeleton props. Easy Halloween home decor ideas for the living room, mantel and party table. #ad #halloweendecor #halloweenhome #ukhalloween
intro: Turn the living room spooky-cosy in an evening with these highly rated indoor Halloween buys - no carving or ladders required.

products.name: Eldnacele Flameless Pillar Candles with Timer
products.headline: Flickering candlelight with zero fire risk
products.why: Real-wax LED candles with a 6-hour timer so they glow every evening without you remembering to switch them on, and they're safe around kids and pets.

products.name: Eambrite Pumpkin, Bat & Ghost Fairy Lights Set of 3
products.headline: Instant spooky glow for shelves and windows
products.why: Three battery-powered light strings in pumpkin, bat and ghost shapes that drape easily along mantels, banisters or a mirror frame for a warm Halloween glow.
products.photo_query: orange fairy lights halloween pumpkin string lights

products.name: Orange & Black Halloween Balloon Garland Arch Kit
products.headline: A doorway statement that takes minutes to build
products.why: A big, photogenic backdrop for a Halloween party or trick-or-treat night, with enough pre-sorted orange and black balloons to frame a doorway or fireplace.

products.name: JOYIN 2 PCS 24" Posable Skeletons
products.headline: Spooky props that pose however you like
products.why: Movable joints mean these can be draped over a sofa, propped on a shelf or hung from a doorway, and shoppers rate them well for the price.
